# Rainmakers

> Rainmakers is an Italian entrepreneurial ecosystem, based in Milan and active since 2011, connecting founders, entrepreneurs and professionals with people, knowledge, communities and business opportunities.

Rainmakers is not a VC fund, an accelerator, a consultancy or just a community: its value is access to an ecosystem — people, knowledge, community, opportunities — rather than to a single service.

## What Rainmakers offers
- Network: entrepreneurs, professionals and ecosystem players
- Knowledge: practical knowledge and learning shared by people who build companies
- Communities: private, curated communities for entrepreneurs (access by request)
- Opportunities: partnerships, collaborations and business opportunities
- Ecosystem: Italian Rainforest, the map and database of the Italian innovation ecosystem

## Who it is for
Entrepreneurs, startup founders (idea to growth) and scaleup founders. Also investors, corporate innovation teams, accelerators, incubators, institutions and professionals who work with entrepreneurs.

## Italian Rainforest
Italian Rainforest (https://italian-innovation-map.vercel.app/en) is the map and database of the Italian innovation ecosystem, created by Rainmakers: venture capital funds, incubators, accelerators, startup studios, angel networks, coworking spaces and institutions. Open data under a copyleft licence for non-commercial use.
Relationship: Rainmakers helps people connect; Italian Rainforest helps people discover the ecosystem they can connect to; Rainmakers communities are where the conversations happen.
